Checklist complete — all 78 rules in `docs/engineering/sources/rules.json` were generated and considered. No tracked files were modified.

## Findings

### 1. The full network list is now reachable only with a mouse — `apps/web/src/components/safe-apps/SafeAppPreviewDrawer/index.tsx:100`
`render={<span className="inline-flex origin-left scale-85" />}` overrides Base UI's trigger, which renders a `<button>` by default. `Tooltip.Trigger` wires `useFocus` but never adds `tabIndex`, so a bare `<span>` is not focusable and the tooltip never opens via keyboard. Its hover interaction is created with `mouseOnly: true`, which bails for touch pointer types. Before this change all chains were rendered inline and visible to everyone; now chains 4..n are unreachable for keyboard and touch users. The two existing call sites of this exact pattern keep the default button trigger and nest the span *inside* it — `SpaceAddressBookTable.tsx:63-65` and `PendingRequestsTable.tsx:146-148`. Match that shape, or add `tabIndex={0}`.
**Rule: UX-03** (shell rewrites must port over user-relied UX features).

### 2. Third verbatim copy of the chain-cluster-with-tooltip block — `apps/web/src/components/safe-apps/SafeAppPreviewDrawer/index.tsx:98-111`
Identical to `apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SpaceAddressBook/SpaceAddressBookTable.tsx:62-76` and `apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SpaceAddressBook/PendingRequestsTable.tsx:146-166`: same `Tooltip`/`TooltipTrigger`, same `inline-flex origin-left scale-85`, same `NetworkLogosList … showHasMore maxVisible={3}`, same `flex flex-col gap-1` + `ChainIndicator` list. Extract one component (e.g. `ChainLogosWithTooltip({ chainIds })`) — the accessibility fix above then lands in one place instead of three.
**Rules: CODE-01, CODE-02.**

### 3. Loading and empty states dropped — `apps/web/src/components/safe-apps/SafeAppPreviewDrawer/index.tsx:43` and `:98-111`
`useChains()` returns `configs: []` while the chains query is in flight, so `knownChainIds` is empty and "Available networks" renders an empty cluster until config resolves. The old code rendered `ChainIndicator`, which shows a `Skeleton` in exactly that case (`ChainIndicator/index.tsx:49,84`). `loading` and `error` from `useChains()` are both unused. Separately, when `knownChainIds` is empty the `Tooltip` still mounts, so hovering pops an empty tooltip bubble — guard the whole block on `knownChainIds.length > 0`.
**Rules: DATA-02, RTK-02; AGENTS.md pitfall #6.**

### 4. `any` in the component mock — `apps/web/src/components/safe-apps/SafeAppPreviewDrawer/index.test.tsx:8`
`({ networks, maxVisible, showHasMore }: any)` violates AGENTS.md ("Never use the `any` type!"). This is not only style: the mock *is* the consumer's contract for `NetworkLogosList`, and typed as `any` it keeps passing silently if the real prop names change. Use `ComponentProps<typeof NetworkLogosList>`.
**Rule: TEST-04.**

### 5. Test name claims behavior the assertion never checks — `apps/web/src/components/safe-apps/SafeAppPreviewDrawer/index.test.tsx:71-76`
"passes every chain to the cluster so overflow collapses beyond the visible limit" only asserts the length of the array handed to a mocked component. `NetworkLogosList` is mocked, so no collapsing happens and the `+N` overflow indicator is never asserted. Rename it to what it checks, or render the real component.
**Rule: TEST-01.**

### 6. Assertions bound to mock props rather than rendered output — `apps/web/src/components/safe-apps/SafeAppPreviewDrawer/index.test.tsx:67-68`
`data-max-visible` / `data-show-has-more` assert that two literal props were forwarded. They break on a harmless prop rename and pass if rendering is broken. The repo's precedent for asserting shadcn tooltip content is to mock `@/components/ui/tooltip` and render the real child — `SidebarIndexingStatus.test.tsx:25-29`.
**Rule: TEST-01.**

### 7. Hover test leans on a 600ms real-timer delay — `apps/web/src/components/safe-apps/SafeAppPreviewDrawer/index.test.tsx:78-88`
Base UI's tooltip `OPEN_DELAY` is 600ms and opening runs through a rest timer fed by `mousemove`; `waitFor` defaults to a 1000ms timeout, leaving ~400ms of margin under CI load. The one other `user.hover` test in the repo (`ActionsTray.test.tsx:233`) targets a *MUI* tooltip, which has no such delay — it is not precedent for this. Moderate confidence; I did not run the suite.

### 8. Minor — derived value allocated inside JSX — `apps/web/src/components/safe-apps/SafeAppPreviewDrawer/index.tsx:101`
`knownChainIds.map((chainId) => ({ chainId }))` builds a new array in the JSX attribute on every render; hoist it next to `knownChainIds`. Low priority — the existing call sites do the same.
**Rule: CODE-04.**

### 9. Minor — no Storybook story — `apps/web/src/components/safe-apps/SafeAppPreviewDrawer/index.tsx`
The component gained conditional rendering (collapsed/overflow/empty). `apps/web/AGENTS.md:147` asks for a story for components with logic; strictly it applies to *new* components, so treat this as optional. Also worth noting: this file now imports two different `Tooltip` implementations (MUI at `:9`, shadcn at `:12-16`), forcing the `Networks*` aliases — extracting finding #2 removes that collision.

**Rules that produced findings:** UX-03, CODE-01, CODE-02, CODE-04, DATA-02, RTK-02, TEST-01, TEST-04.
